properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 IPAM routing and RPKI activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "BatchModifyIpamRoutingPolicyRegistrations", "Set", "IPAM Routing Policy Registration Delta",
    "CreateIpamInternetRegistryAssociation", "Create", "IPAM Internet Registry Association",
    "CreateIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration", "Create", "IPAM Routing Policy Registration Delta",
    "DeleteIpamInternetRegistryAssociation", "Delete", "IPAM Internet Registry Association",
    "DeleteIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration", "Delete", "IPAM Routing Policy Registration Delta",
    "DescribeIpamInternetRegistryAssociations", "Read", "IPAM Internet Registry Association",
    "EnableIpamInternetRegistryAssociation", "Enable", "IPAM Internet Registry Association",
    "GetIpamDiscoveredRoutes", "Read", "IPAM Discovered Route",
    "GetIpamInternetRegistryAssociationAsns", "Read", "IPAM Internet Registry Association",
    "GetIpamInternetRegistryAssociationCidrs", "Read", "IPAM Internet Registry Association",
    "GetIpamRouteOriginAuthorizations", "Read", "IPAM Route Origin Authorization",
    "GetIpamRouteProtectionFindings", "Read", "IPAM Route Protection Finding",
    "GetIpamRoutingPolicyRegistrationDeltas", "Read", "IPAM Routing Policy Registration Delta",
    "GetIpamRoutingPolicyRegistrations", "Read", "IPAM Routing Policy Registration",
    "ModifyIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration", "Set", "IPAM Routing Policy Registration Delta"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName in ("BatchModifyIpamRoutingPolicyRegistrations", "CreateIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration",
        "ModifyIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration"), ResponseElements.ipamRoutingPolicyRegistrationDelta,
      EventName in ("CreateIpamInternetRegistryAssociation", "EnableIpamInternetRegistryAssociation"),
        ResponseElements.ipamInternetRegistryAssociation,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("BatchModifyIpamRoutingPolicyRegistrations", "CreateIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration",
        "DeleteIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration", "ModifyIpamRoutingPolicyRegistration"),
        ResponseElements.ipamRoutingPolicyRegistrationDelta.deltaId,
      EventName == "CreateIpamInternetRegistryAssociation",
        ResponseElements.ipamInternetRegistryAssociation.ipamInternetRegistryAssociationId,
      EventName in ("DeleteIpamInternetRegistryAssociation", "EnableIpamInternetRegistryAssociation",
        "GetIpamInternetRegistryAssociationAsns", "GetIpamInternetRegistryAssociationCidrs"),
        coalesce(RequestParameters.ipamInternetRegistryAssociationId,
        RequestParameters.IpamInternetRegistryAssociationId),
      EventName == "GetIpamRoutingPolicyRegistrationDeltas", coalesce(RequestParameters.deltaId,
        RequestParameters.DeltaId),
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
